business_overview.one_sentence: Yunfeng Financial is an insurance-led financial group, with YF Life as the main profit contributor and other financial services/corporate activities including investment management, brokerage, financing and fintech support.

segments.name: Insurance business
segments.source: Annual report 2025, Note 16 segment reporting, p.331

segments.name: Other financial services and corporate
segments.source: Annual report 2025, Note 16 segment reporting, p.331

business_overview.revenue_model: Insurance revenue, investment return allocated to insurance liabilities, investment management fees and other financial service income.
business_notes: Core business activities were disclosed as materially unchanged from 2024.
Insurance revenue was HK$3,075.520 million and consolidated profit attributable to owners was HK$652.550 million in 2025.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Insurance and financial-group cash flows are dominated by investment portfolio, policyholder balances and insurance contract movements. They are not comparable to ordinary industrial free cash flow and are not used as an ordinary distributable-cash denominator.

evidence.business_substance: Financial statements are expressed in Hong Kong dollars and primary tables are in HK$'000.

gaps: The annual report does not split all group cash between listed parent, operating subsidiaries and insurance regulated funds beyond segment cash/fixed deposits.
No ordinary-enterprise maintenance capex estimate is meaningful because the main business is insurance and financial services.
Only 2025 annual report was extracted; 2023 operating cash flow and capex were not re-extracted from the 2023/2024 annual report.
